info.name: BidMart — Complaints
info.description:
Complete REST coverage for the Complaints module — user side, admin side, and complaint-type management.

**Seeded accounts (all environments):**
| Role   | Phone / Email            | Password      |
|--------|--------------------------|---------------|
| Buyer  | +966500000003 (Omar)     | Buyer@123456  |
| Buyer  | +971500000001 (Sara)     | Buyer@123456  |
| Buyer  | +96550000001  (Khalid)   | Buyer@123456  |
| Seller | +966500000002 (Ahmed)    | Seller@123456 |
| Admin  | admin@bidmart.com        | Admin@123     |

**Seeded complaints:**
1. Omar → Item Not Received → UNDER_REVIEW (2 messages, 1 admin note)
2. Sara → Damaged Item → RESOLVED (1 message, resolution note, conv closed)
3. Khalid → Other → REJECTED (no messages, resolution note, conv closed)
4. Omar → Seller Misconduct → UNDER_REVIEW (3 messages, conversation manually closed)

**Recommended run order:**
1. 🔑 Setup — Login (all 4 login requests)
2. 📋 Complaint Types → List Types (sets `complaintTypeId`)
3. 👤 User → Submit Complaint (sets `complaintId`)
4. 👤 User → List My Complaints as Sara (sets `resolvedComplaintId`)
5. 🛡 Admin → View & Filter → List All Complaints
6. 🛡 Admin → Actions → Start Investigation (transitions `complaintId` to IN_PROGRESS)
7. 👤 User → Get Support Conversations → unified shape (source, otherParticipant, conversationClosed)
8. 👤 User → Get Complaint Messages (sets `messageCursor`)
9. Remaining requests in any order

**Inbox response shape (v2 — unified):**
GET /complaints/support/active now returns the same `UnifiedInboxItem` shape as GET /inbox. Fields `chatAvailable`, `chatClosedReason`, `complaint_type`, and `status` are no longer in the list response — fetch GET /complaints/:id to get those when opening a specific complaint.

⚠️  Real-time chat messages are sent via Socket.IO (`/complaint-chat` namespace), NOT via REST. Use the complaint-chat tester at `/complaint-chat-tester` for socket testing.

item.name: 🛡 Admin — Actions
item.description: State-changing admin endpoints. Recommended order: Start → Add Note → Notify → [chat via socket] → Close Conversation (optional) → Resolve or Reject.

request.description:
Transitions complaint from UNDER_REVIEW to IN_PROGRESS. This:
- Activates the /complaint-chat socket chat
- Emits `complaint:status:updated` to the user's socket
- Sends a push notification to the user
- Logs 'started_investigation' in activities[]

After this, the user's GET /complaints/support/active will return 200.
Sara's complaint is RESOLVED — cannot be started. Expects 409 COMPLAINT_ALREADY_CLOSED. Run 'List My Complaints — Sara' first to populate resolvedComplaintId.

Appends an internal note attributed to this admin. Returns 201 + ComplaintNoteItem { id, adminName, note, createdAt }. Notes are NEVER returned in user-facing endpoints. Allowed while status is UNDER_REVIEW or IN_PROGRESS.
Multiple notes can be added to the same complaint, each attributed separately. Run List Notes to see all.

item.name: Add Note — 409 Complaint Already Closed (Sara's RESOLVED)

request.description: Expects 409 — notes are read-only on RESOLVED/REJECTED complaints.
Returns all internal notes in chronological order. Each note includes: id, adminName (resolved from the admins table), note, createdAt.
Dispatches a custom in-app push notification to the complaint submitter. Available regardless of complaint status (1–500 chars). Returns 204. Action is logged in activities[].
Expects 400 — message cannot be empty.

Closes the chat thread without changing complaint status. After this:
- Neither admin nor user can send further messages (COMPLAINT_CONVERSATION_CLOSED)
- Socket emits `complaint:conversation:closed` to all participants
- chatClosedReason becomes 'manually_closed'
- Complaint status remains unchanged (still IN_PROGRESS or UNDER_REVIEW)
- Use /resolve or /reject to actually close the complaint
Run after 'Close Conversation' — expects 422 COMPLAINT_CONVERSATION_CLOSED. Also returns 422 for Sara's seeded complaint which has conversation_closed: true.

Marks complaint as RESOLVED. Allowed from UNDER_REVIEW or IN_PROGRESS. This:
- Saves resolution_note (visible to user)
- Sets conversation_closed = true
- Emits `complaint:closed` with status 'resolved' via socket
- Sends push notification to user
- Logs 'resolved' in activities[]
Sara's complaint is already RESOLVED. Expects 409 COMPLAINT_ALREADY_CLOSED.

Khalid's complaint is already seeded as REJECTED — this will return 409 on a fresh DB. Submit a new complaint as Khalid to get a fresh complaintId, then use that here. Allowed from UNDER_REVIEW or IN_PROGRESS.
Expects 400 VALIDATION_FAILED — rejection_reason is required.
